text:
maria: heads up — overnight eval flagged a weird failure pattern in the few-shot cohort. saw spikes in 'formatting hallucinations' on a small subset. linking alert: https://evals.redwood/company/alert/2135008888

eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-suite v3.4 failed on cohorts: [cohort-pivot-A, summarization-long-context]. metric deltas: instr-qa_accuracy -7.2%, sample-coherence -0.34. severity: initial = medium. run_id=2026-03-20-04:00

sachin: looking now. first-pass: examples in cohort-pivot-A changed order and one of the few-shot exemplars got truncated during ingestion (likely newline stripping). that would explain the abrupt list/numbering hallucinations.

pei: can you point to the ingestion job? is this from the new snapshot pipeline?

maria: @pei yep — dataset-snapshot job `snapshots/2026-03-19-22` was used. see manifest: `s3://redwood-evals/snapshots/2026-03-19-22/manifest.json`

sachin: repro on local quick run with the broken promptset:
```
# quick repro
python -m evals.run --suite instruct-qa --cohort cohort-pivot-A --model rwd-ggml-1b --fewshot 4
```
output: multiple answers start with "1." then text fused into the same line, not separated — model picks up malformed example spacing.

emily: initial severity for product? our dashboard shows ~0.6% user-impact if deployed but generation quality issues concentrated on a narrow template. incline to mark P2 but notify growth team.

maria: agree P2 for now. assign owners: @sachin to fix exemplar ingestion, @pei to audit snapshot pipeline, I'll own re-running the nightly and communicating to growth.

pei: quick note — ingestion job has a new trimming step we rolled last week for long examples. plausible that trimming removed final newline. rolling back that change for snapshots older than 2026-03-18 might be safest short-term.

sachin: plan: restore original exemplar file from backups, add a sanitizer that preserves trailing newlines for few-shot files, then re-run a focused nightly on cohort-pivot-A and summarization-long-context. timeline: restore + sanitizer PR today EOD; re-run tomorrow morning.

maria: action items:
- sachin: restore exemplar + PR for sanitizer (owner)
- pei: audit trimming change, temp rollback for affected snapshots (owner)
- maria: kick focused nightly and notify growth, update incident tracker

eval-bot: Scheduled run created: focused-nightly/2135008888-repro-run (ETA 2026-03-21 05:30 UTC).

emily: thanks. when the focused run completes, please drop a short summary here with metrics (accuracy delta, coherence). also tag me if user-facing impact shows >1%.

sachin: noted. I'll paste quick diff once run finishes. starting restore now.

maria: anything else? otherwise closing this thread for now and will update with results. :white_check_mark:

pei: one small follow-up — adding a unit test to the snapshot pipeline to detect trailing newline removal. will include in rollback PR.

maria: perfect. thanks all.
